newsitem.title: USA: Conseco to acquire insurance companies.
newsitem.headline: Conseco to acquire insurance companies.

text.p: Conseco Inc said Monday it would acquire two insurance companies and increase its stakes in two others, giving it full ownership of those firms.
Conseco said it would acquire American Travellers Corp, which provides long-term care insurance, for about $793 million in Conseco stock.
It said it had agreed to buy Capitol American Financial Corp, which provides cancer insurance and other supplemental health insurance products, for about $650 milion in cash and Conseco stock.

Conseco said it is distributing the stock of American Life Holdings, previously held by Conseco Capital Partners II LP, to all partners. Conseco said it then intends to acquire the stock of American Life Holdings that it does not alredy own, for about $165 million in cash.
American Life provides retirement savings annuities.

Conseco also said it intends to merge with Bankers Life Holding Corp, which sells supplemental health insurance products for senior citizens. It also will acquire the outstanding shares of Bankers Life that it does not already own for about $117 million in Conseco stock.
"The life insurance industry is undergoing rapid consolidation," Conseco Chairman Stephen Hilbert said in a statement. "Conseco is positioned as a proven consolidator."
He said the company is focusing on acquisitions that complement its long-term business strategy and maintain both its earnings momentum and its conservative capital structure.
